observations.rollback_is_stage_only: Deploy rollback has one Deploy action; Source and Downstream retain v2 ownership and final/value.txt stays v2.
observations.eligibility: Unknown stage/UUID reject; malformed UUID ValidationException; definition updates reject PipelineExecutionOutdatedException; target must have completed successfully in stage and must not itself be ROLLBACK.
observations.modes: SUPERSEDED, QUEUED and PARALLEL rollback executions all reached Succeeded in boundaries capture.
observations.identity: New execution UUID; ROLLBACK type; ManualRollback trigger with JSON AwsUserArn; rollbackMetadata target ID; target pipeline variables and execution revision history.
observations.source_guide_discrepancy: Guide says source cannot roll back. Two API captures accepted. Detailed capture source action used current v2 and new artifact; execution history still reported target v1; stage state showed actual current v2.
observations.stop_retry: Active stage and concurrent rollback reject UnableToRollbackStageException. Stopped current stage admits rollback; active rollback stop-abandon succeeds and stopped rollback ALL_ACTIONS retry succeeds.
limitations: No native transition-disabled rollback or quota/retention expiry calibration.
No assertion that exact messages or timestamps are universal.
